iBlueSky is a mind mapping application for the iPhone, and this mashup allows users to save mind maps from iBlueSky directly to their Box.net accounts.
TheInterviewr lets media workers (journalists, bloggers, etc.) schedule and prepare for interviews. Interviews are conducted using Twilio's calling functions.

Compare California schools side-by-side in Virtual Earth with the school rankings, course offerings, and other details. The information provided on this website comes from the California Department of Education.
SnapWidget allows you to display your Instagram photos on your website or blog using an easily customizable and embeddable widget.
Tracking campaign appearances by major candidates. In French.

Lets sellers create a web catalog from their shops. It can be used as the seller homepage, because it integrates Twitter, Blog, and Etsy accounts. It also can be widgetized and included in any other website.
This tool searches Flickr to count sightings of Monarch Butterflies and display the results on Google Maps. It helps visualize the increase/decrease year over year.
This mashup allows you to create any kind or number of records in BatchBook directly from a Formstack form submission.

Social Interest is a system for connecting families with a range of publicly funded health and human service programs in California. Communities can use it to screen people for programs such as Medi-Cal, Healthy Families, local health insurance programs.
Content based visual image search application for Flickr. Look for an image you like, then Find Similar photos either by subject matter mode or color and texture mode.
Buoy Alarm is an easy way to predict, observe and record ocean conditions. Provide ocean enthusiasts with the information they need to act with confidence.
